findings.title: Extractor and processor disagree on pending apply_patch
findings.problem: The extractor counts a result-less apply_patch in tools.apply_patch and backfills it as a failure, while the processor emits no delta until a result arrives.
findings.impact: Local summary and synced records report different apply_patch and failure counts for the same rollout, violating spec S2/AC3.
findings.recommendation: Treat pending calls identically in both paths (skip in the extractor, or emit in both); update the extractor test expecting failure 3 including call_pending.
findings.check_notes: Extractor now skips calls with no result; test pins it and failure count 2.

fix.change: extractor skips result-less apply_patch calls, matching the processor

findings.title: Idle tick overwrites in-flight tick promise
findings.problem: When the interval fires during a running tick, tick() returns at once via tickInFlight, and its instant promise replaces the real one in tickPromises.
findings.impact: stopCodexIncrementalSync awaits the no-op promise, so the running tick can still write after the final pass and revert the stored active duration.
findings.recommendation: Do not store a new promise when tickInFlight is already true, so stop awaits the real running tick.
findings.check_notes: Interval callback returns early when tickInFlight is set; new stop test covers it.

fix.change: interval callback returns early while a tick is in flight, so stop awaits the real tick

findings.title: Parent-rollout active time wiring untested
findings.problem: storeActiveDuration computes duration from the resolved parent rollout, but every lifecycle test mocks resolveParentRollout as identity.
findings.impact: A regression that passes the child rollout would undercount active time with no failing test; spec S3 requires this to be pinned.
findings.recommendation: Add a lifecycle test with a child picked rollout and a parent file holding the turns, asserting activeDurationMs equals the parent's turn time.
findings.check_notes: Lifecycle test resolves a parent rollout and asserts 45000 ms from the parent.

fix.change: lifecycle test with child picked rollout and parent holding the turns

findings.title: codex.session.ts exceeds 500-line limit
findings.problem: The file grew from 474 to 572 lines; codex.plugin.ts is also 596 lines.
findings.impact: Violates the code-quality guide's file-size limit, which the standards audit treats as blocking.
findings.recommendation: Move the new rollout-family loading helpers into a separate module under session/.
findings.check_notes: Helpers moved to session/codex-rollout-family.ts; codex.session.ts is 449 lines. codex.plugin.ts 596 untouched.

fix.change: rollout family helpers moved to session/codex-rollout-family.ts and re-exported; codex.session.ts now 449 lines

findings.title: outputFailed text heuristic misclassifies successes
findings.problem: Output beginning with error/failed or containing verification failed is treated as failure even when an exit code says success. Reachability unconfirmed.
findings.impact: A successful patch can be counted as failed and its file operations dropped.
findings.recommendation: Prefer a numeric exit_code when present (exit !== 0) before the text heuristic.
findings.check_notes: Numeric exit_code now decides before the text heuristic; test added.

fix.change: numeric exit_code decides outcome before text heuristic

findings.title: Family fallback drops sub-agent rollouts
findings.problem: When loadRolloutFamilyRecords throws, familyRecords returns only the picked records, whereas the no-rolloutPath branch also keeps session.subagents.
findings.impact: Sub-agent apply_patch calls loaded in the session go uncounted on that error path.
findings.recommendation: Return [...records, ...subagents.flatMap((s) => s.messages as CodexRolloutRecord[])] in the catch.
findings.check_notes: Catch branch keeps sub-agent messages; test added.

fix.change: family fallback keeps loaded sub-agent records

findings.title: Commit subjects embed ticket key
findings.problem: 7 of 8 commit subjects contain EPMCDME-17102; git-workflow.md puts the ticket in the footer.
findings.impact: Documented commit-format standard is not met across the review range.
findings.recommendation: Reword the subjects to drop the ticket key and add it to the commit footer.
findings.check_notes: No fix_evidence mapped; commits are rewritten after this round, as the caller stated.
